label: Alafasy 4:19 60 ms أَن stamped on the rewind to إِلَّآ
notes: Alafasy says a short إِلَّا (21.44-22.36 s), breathes, then restarts it with its madd (22.74-24.46 s) before أَن. The old one_utterance correction read 17,[18],17,18 as a false loop and dropped the second إِلَّآ, leaving 2.1 s of recitation unlit. The 520 ms middle labels of the ear-verified 2:229/2:235 loops are far above this floor.
